title: Reproducibility package for: Localization–Detection Trade-offs in Industrial Anomaly Scoring at Near-Matched Memory Budgets: A Controlled 27-Category Study
description: Frozen 135-record A/B results, historical PCA result tables, statistical recomputation code, table and figure generation code, experiment runners, protocol manifests, and measurement notes for a controlled 27-category comparison of five anomaly-detection scorers on MVTec AD and VisA. The package includes CPU-verified recomputation, tables, and figures. It does not include dataset images or pretrained weights. This is release-preparation metadata; the record has not been published and no DOI has been assigned.
notes: File-level mixed licensing: the 33 authors' original Python files marked MIT-covered in LICENSE_CODE_SCOPE.md are released under MIT; the authors' derived result tables, figures, and documentation are released under CC BY 4.0. The repository as a whole is not MIT-licensed. These licenses do not apply to third-party datasets, weights, or libraries, which remain under their original licenses. src/metrics/metrics.py was removed from the public copy because its anomalib-related provenance is unresolved. MVTec AD is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the VisA dataset is CC BY 4.0 (VisA source code is separately Apache-2.0); OpenCLIP weights are not included and remain under their original licenses.
